title: Evaluation of Lung Permeability by FITC-Dextran Intravenous Injection
author: Laura Ruiz Remolina
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.j8hcrt6
materials: 3-We put in the nebulization chamber the mice

steps.title: Set up nebulization chamber
steps.instruction: Place the chamber connected to the nebulizer inside a laminar flow hood.

steps.title: Load LPS solution
steps.instruction: Load 10 ml of a 5 mg ml⁻¹ LPS dilution into the nebulizer vessel.

steps.title: Nebulize LPS for 30 min
steps.instruction: Turn on the nebulizer and run for 30 minutes, confirming mist formation by visible droplets condensing in the outlet tube.

steps.title: Post‑nebulization incubation
steps.instruction: Turn off the nebulizer and keep the mice inside the chamber for an additional 10 minutes.

steps.title: Remove mice and decontaminate
steps.instruction: After a total of 40 minutes, remove the mice, transfer them to their cage, discard all gloves and any material that contacted LPS in a sealed garbage bag, and wash the gas chamber and nebulizer to eliminate LPS residue.

substeps.instruction: Take mice out of the chamber and place them in their cage.
Dispose of gloves and LPS‑contaminated items in a closed garbage bag.
Wash the gas chamber and nebulizer thoroughly to remove LPS debris.

steps.title: Inject FITC‑Dextran
steps.instruction: Twenty‑four hours later, anesthetize each mouse with isoflurane (forane) and inject 100 μl of FITC‑Dextran (25 mg ml⁻¹) into the retro‑orbital sinus.

substeps.instruction: Inject 100 μl of 25 mg ml⁻¹ FITC‑Dextran into the retro‑orbital sinus.

steps.title: Euthanize mice
steps.instruction: Thirty minutes after injection, euthanize the mouse using CO₂.

steps.title: Expose trachea
steps.instruction: Isolate the trachea, carefully cleaning the conjunctiva and surrounding fat.

steps.title: Secure trachea with thread
steps.instruction: Using tweezers, pass a thread beneath the trachea and form a loose bundle without squeezing.

steps.title: Create tracheal entry
steps.instruction: With scissors, make a small incision in the trachea and insert a round‑tip needle.

steps.title: Tie securing knots
steps.instruction: Tighten a first knot to prevent needle dislodgement, then add a second tightening knot.

steps.title: Perform bronchoalveolar lavage
steps.instruction: Gradually instill 500 μl of 1X heparinized PBS into the lungs; the chest will visibly swell.

steps.title: Collect lavage fluid
steps.instruction: Slowly withdraw the lavage, tilting the mouse as needed; typically recover 300–400 μl due to needle dead volume.

steps.title: Centrifuge lavage
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the collected lavage at 300 g for 10 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Obtain blood sample
steps.instruction: Perform a thoracotomy, cut the caudal vena cava, and collect blood with a heparinized syringe; keep the sample on ice.

substeps.instruction: Perform thoracotomy and cut the caudal vena cava.
Collect blood using a heparinized syringe.
Place the blood sample on ice.

steps.title: Measure fluorescence
steps.instruction: Collect supernatant, dilute plasma 1:20, take 100 μl of BALF, and measure fluorescence on a fluorimeter (excitation 485 nm, emission 528 nm).

substeps.instruction: Measure 100 μl of BALF and diluted plasma fluorescence (excitation 485 nm, emission 528 nm).

steps.title: Calculate normalized FITC‑Dextran
steps.instruction: Normalize FITC‑Dextran concentrations by dividing BALF fluorescence and lung homogenate fluorescence by the corresponding blood fluorescence (BALF / Blood; Lung / Blood).
